proposals.why: Small step down from 0.173: on the scoreboard the model's log-loss is worse than the market's in all six stats (e.g. ast 0.6973 vs 0.6861 on 1018, reb 0.7017 vs 0.6852 on 1092), and the prop model side averages -4.0% CLV on 539 lines, beating the close only 7.6% of the time.

matchup_under is the only playbook past 30 bets (34) and it trails the close: -2.96% average CLV on 28 closes and -$46.65 on $170 staked (-27%), so trim prop volume from 4 to 3 per run until CLV turns.

summary: The book is behind the close overall (-1.15% CLV on 62 bets, -26% ROI), and the only playbook with a real sample, matchup_under (34 bets), is the main leak at -2.96% CLV. The prop model loses to the market on log-loss in every stat and its edge buckets show no CLV improvement at higher edges (10%+ at -3.8% vs 6-10% at -3.5%), so raising prop_min_edge isn't supported; leaning more on the market and cutting prop volume is. Game-side playbooks (longshot 5, arb 6, value_fav 1, matchup_over 8) are too small to touch, and value_dog is already paused.
